title: Rapid and Efficient Induction of Functional Astrocytes from Human Pluripotent Stem Cells
protocol: Mix 75 μg of transcription factor plasmids with 30 μg of PMDLg/pRRE, 22 μg of pMD2.G, and 15 μg of pRSV-Rev plasmids for two T175 flasks.
Transfect HEK 293T cells with the mixture using 2.5 M CaCl2.
Change medium 16 hours after transfection.
Harvest viruses 48 hours post-transfection.
Centrifuge harvested viruses at 20,000 x g for 2 hours at 4°C.
Resuspend pelleted viruses in 100 μl DMEM.
Aliquot resuspended viruses and store at -80°C.
Dissociate hESC or hiPSC with Accutase and replate 5x10^5 cells per well in Matrigel-coated 6-well plates with mTeSR1 containing 10 μM Rock inhibitor.
Aspire medium on Day -1 and add 2 ml of fresh mTeSR1 containing 8 μg/ml Polybrene per well.
Add 1 μl of each virus to the wells on Day -1.
Aspire medium on Day 0 and add 2 ml of fresh mTeSR1 containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline per well.
Aspire medium on Days 1 and 2, then add 2 ml of Expansion Medium with 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline, 1.25 μg/ml Puromycin, and 200 μg/ml Hygromycin per well.
Aspire medium on Day 3 and add 2 ml of a mixture consisting of 3:4 Expansion Medium to 1:4 FGF Medium with 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline and 200 μg/ml Hygromycin per well.
Aspire medium on Day 4 and add 2 ml of a mixture consisting of 1:1 Expansion Medium to FGF Medium with 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline and 200 μg/ml Hygromycin per well.
Aspire medium from each well.
Add 2 ml of a mixture consisting of 1:4 Expansion Medium and 3:4 FGF Medium containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline and 200 μg/ml Hygromycin per well.
On Day 6, aspire the medium from each well.
Add 2 ml of FGF Medium containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline to each well.
On Day 7, dissociate cells with Accutase.
Pellet the cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Replate the pelleted cells in Matrigel-coated coverslips, petri dishes or wells according to desired output.
Use FGF Medium containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline as necessary.
On Day 8, aspire the medium from each well.
Add fresh FGF Medium containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline to each well.
On Day 10, aspirate half of the medium from each well.
Add an equal amount of Maturation Medium containing 2.5 μg/ml Doxycycline.
Change half of the medium every 2-3 days thereafter.
